name: AnyDoc
description: Converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files to GitHub-Flavored Markdown for LLMs, via a CLI or Rust, Node, Python, and WASM libraries.

skills.name: Markdown Conversion
skills.description: Converts office documents, EPUB, CSV, and text-based PDFs into one consistent GitHub-Flavored Markdown output.

skills.name: Format Detection
skills.description: Detects a document's format from its bytes, such as PDF headers and ZIP mimetypes, so mislabeled files still convert.

skills.name: Equations As LaTeX
skills.description: Converts Word, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, EPUB, and RTF equations into inline and block GitHub-flavored math.

skills.name: Hosted OCR Fallback
skills.description: Sends scanned or image-only PDFs to Firecrawl Parse for OCR when opted in with an API key, returning the same Markdown.

skills.name: Document Conversion Skill
skills.description: Installs as an Agent Skill with npx skills add firecrawl/anydoc so coding agents convert documents with the CLI.
